themes.name: Teal Ledger
themes.description: The wordmark's teal on cool, barely-tinted greys. Calm and closest to the current mockups.

themes.name: Indigo Root
themes.description: The mark's root indigo with lavender-tinted neutrals taken from the icon surface.

themes.name: Moss Paper
themes.description: A deepened lime (moss) on warm paper. Earthy, the most 'substrate' of the five.

themes.name: Coral Clay
themes.description: The bracket coral, darkened for text contrast, on warm clay neutrals.

themes.name: Spore Pink
themes.description: The cap pink, deepened to raspberry, on faintly rosy neutrals. The boldest light option.

themes.name: Night Soil
themes.description: The icon's night indigo as the base, periwinkle accent. Matches the dark app icon exactly.

themes.name: Deep Teal
themes.description: Blue-green depths with the wordmark's light teal. Continuous with Teal Ledger.

themes.name: Graphite Spore
themes.description: Neutral graphite, so the OS chrome feels native, with the cap pink as a single bright accent.

themes.name: Forest Floor
themes.description: Green-black soil with a lime accent. Pairs with Moss Paper.

themes.name: Ember Clay
themes.description: Warm charcoal with the light coral accent. Pairs with Coral Clay.
